title: The Brew Shop 12 Wines of Christmas (pre-order only!)
contentHtml:
We're excited to bring back The Brew Shop 12 Wines of Christmas (step aside drummers drumming!). Inside our festive box, you'll find 12 wines to sip through December. Available in limited quantities and by pre-order only, make sure you grab your box before they sell out!

Our 12 Wines of Christmas will be hand-selected by your favorite winos (Beth, Julie & Aidan) and filled with never-before-seen-in-the-shop wines perfect to pair with your holidays. What's inside is a surprise, but expect the following -- each box will contain TWO sparklers, THREE whites, SIX reds and ONE wild card. Our holiday elves will wrap each box to keep the surprises coming!


12 Wines of Christmas boxes will be available for pick-up beginning Friday, December 4th.
